about_the_game:
**Welcome to the apocalypse**​

In Drone Simulator: SMASH ZOMBIES, you command a state-of-the-art military drone, the last line of defense against an endless wave of the undead. Navigate treacherous terrains, execute precision strikes, and protect vital resources from being overrun.​

High-Octane Aerial Combat

Engage in fast-paced drone warfare, delivering devastating attacks from above.​ Take direct control of a heavily armed military drone and rain destruction from the skies. Blast through hordes with machine guns, bombs, mines, and missiles as you strafe the battlefield with surgical precision—or glorious chaos. Every shot counts, and every kill feels earned.

Strategic Base Defense

Construct and upgrade defenses to withstand increasingly challenging zombie assaults. This isn’t just about firepower—it’s about brains and bullets. Position and upgrade turrets, reinforce key structures, and manage resources under pressure. Every wave gets stronger, and every choice could be the difference between survival and annihilation.

Diverse Zombie Enemies

Face various undead types, each with unique behaviors and threats.​ From shambling biters to sprinting freaks and armored monstrosities, each undead variant requires a different approach. Adapt your strategy or get overwhelmed. Some explode. Some dodge. Some just won't die unless you throw the big stuff at them.

Dynamic Environments

Battle through shifting conditions that push your survival instincts to the limit. Face zombie waves under scorching sun, pitch-black nights, torrential rain, and violent storms that can blur your vision and crank up the tension. You’re not just fighting the undead—you’re fighting the world itself.

Progression and Upgrades

Unlock and upgrade drone weapons, gadgets, and base structures. Every choice tailors your playstyle—go full offense with explosive payloads or specialize in tactical defense. Whether you're a calculated commander or a chaotic guns-blazer, there's a path that fits your madness.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent depictions of stylized violence. Players operate a combat drone and engage in continuous shooting of fictional zombie enemies. Blood effects are shown as visual indicators of hits, but the depiction of death is unrealistic and not graphic in nature.

The game does not contain any sexual content, depictions of sexual assault/non-consensual sex, drug or alcohol use, or themes involving self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 / AMD Radeon HD 6570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for low-end systems; originally developed for mobile platforms using Unity URP
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Improved batch count and textures for PC version; URP pipeline used for better rendering efficiency

short_description: Pilot a heavily armed drone to obliterate relentless zombie hordes in this intense action-strategy game. Defend your base, upgrade your arsenal, and experience the ultimate undead-smashing thrill.
